en.title: Houston nonprofit's $800K medical supplies arrive in Gaza

facts: Une organisation non lucrative de Houston a envoyé un envoi de fournitures médicales de 800 000 dollars à Gaza

body: L'organisation non lucrative basée à Houston a fait parvenir un envoi de fournitures médicales d'une valeur de 800 000 dollars à Gaza le 11 novembre 2026. Le Houston Chronicle a rapporté cet arrivage.
Le reportage a été publié à 22 h 46 min 15 s la même date.

body: Suministros médicos de 800.000 dólares de una ONG de Houston llegan a Gaza

El Houston Chronicle informó la llegada de un envío de 800.000 dólares de material médico desde una organización sin ánimo de lucro con sede en Houston a Gaza el 11 de noviembre de 2026. El reportaje se publicó a las 22:46:15 en la misma fecha.

body: ヒューストン・クロニクル紙は、ヒューストンを拠点とする非営利団体による80万ドル相当の医療支援物資が2026年11月11日にガザに到着したと報じた。

problemsFixed: Body sentences 3 and 4 contain dates and times not present in the source text (22:46:15 on 2026-11-11). The source only provides the publication date 2026-11-11 without a specific time. Sentence 4 repeats the date from the dek.
Body sentence 3 is vague ('This delivery involved medical supplies...') and does not add new information from the source.
The dek ('A Houston nonprofit delivered...') contains a claim about delivery that is not explicitly confirmed as a completed delivery in the source text, which only states the shipment 'arrives'.
The body opens with a date ('on 2026-11-11') which violates the rule against opening paragraphs with the same noun that opened the previous paragraph (the dek also contains '2026-11-11').
The context section states 'The provided sources do not offer background...' which is a meta-evaluation, not neutral background from the sources.
The importance value 3 is unsupported by the style guide requirements for factual density.
